heading: National exercise simulation center
lead: The President shall establish a national exercise simulation center that—

tree.text: uses a mix of live, virtual, and constructive simulations to—

children.text: prepare elected officials, emergency managers, emergency response providers, and emergency support providers at all levels of government to operate cohesively;
provide a learning environment for the homeland security personnel of all Federal agencies;
assist in the development of operational procedures and exercises, particularly those based on catastrophic incidents; and
allow incident commanders to exercise decisionmaking in a simulated environment; and

tree.text: uses modeling and simulation for training, exercises, and command and control functions at the operational level.
